regime_context: Big Banks dominate with high durability and crowded positioning, while the absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control edge for the TSX, helping to reduce drawdowns. Cross-sectional momentum ranks serve only as a focus lens, not return forecasts. No confirmed rotation handoff is present, and the macro narrative backdrop (AI/tech, geopolitics) is coincident and offers no per-theme trigger.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream as the rotation challenger with a score of 0.753 and broad participation; watch for a potential leadership handoff if Big Banks' durability weakens. Kill criterion: Big Banks' durability_bar remains above 0.7 and its rank score stays at least 0.8 above Pipelines for 10 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The Big Banks theme exhibits strong trend momentum (rank 1) with high durability (0.74) and passes the absolute-trend gate, which is the only validated risk-control edge for the TSX sector universe. While crowded (crowding_z 1.59) suggests sizing caution, the trend gate favors staying with the theme until eligibility fails.
theses.dissent: Crowding may lead to a sharp mean-reversion if a catalyst (e.g., macro shift, earnings miss) triggers an unwind; momentum rank has no return-predictive power.

falsifier.text: Big Banks theme becomes ineligible (absolute-trend gate fails) or durability_bar falls below 0.5 for 5 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, signaling weak absolute trend health, and holds a negative cross-sectional momentum score (-0.568). The validated risk-control framework suggests avoiding ineligible themes to reduce drawdown exposure, even though its hurst is trend-like; its ineligibility suggests the trend is not sufficiently robust.
theses.dissent: The trend hurst tag and relatively high durability_bar (0.74) could mean it is close to eligibility; if it becomes eligible, the thesis is invalidated.

falsifier.text: Technology becomes eligible (absolute-trend gate passes) and its cross-sectional score turns positive for 5 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
